capabilities.activate_when: The repository contains real backend route registration, controllers/handlers, or an OpenAPI/Swagger contract.
capabilities.exclude_when: Only client-side API calls or SDK models are present and no backend contract is owned by this repository.

capabilities.activate_when: At least one real Flutter application package has pubspec.yaml, lib/main.dart, and a supported platform directory.
capabilities.exclude_when: The repository only contains a Dart package, generated Flutter artifacts, or client code without a runnable Flutter application.
